summary: independent review of the lead's final changes
prompt: You are an adversarial senior reviewer. tmp_review/lead_delta.diff is the lead engineer's final set of changes (after all other reviews): (1) agents/bench.py rewritten as a closed-loop virtual-user load generator with a warm-up phase; (2) a per-deployment random proxy admin token (targets/common/router_token.py) used by targets/proxy/router.py and agents/cutover_agent.py instead of a public default; (3) agents/translator_agent.py: stale-message ties, migrate dedupe across superseded migrations, a requested_at fallback floor, and paged room-history lookup for approval verification (_scan_history); (4) SwitchAgent.read_context(before=...) and the matching FakeRoom semantics. Find REAL defects only: correctness bugs, regressions vs the previous behaviour shown in the diff, races, infinite loops, wrong time/units handling (epoch ms vs ISO), security weaknesses, and tests that would pass while the code is wrong. For each: severity, file:line, a concrete failing scenario, and the minimal fix. No style nits. Markdown with '## Findings' (write 'None.' if none) and '## Verdict'.
